title: fragaria vesca var. roseiflora
intro: Fragaria vesca var. roseiflora, commonly known as the rose-leaf strawberry, is a variety of the wild strawberry plant. This plant is rich in nutrients and has been used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Fragaria vesca var. roseiflora include protecting against oxidative stress, reducing inflammation, and supporting immune function, which may contribute to its potential in preventing chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The bioactive constituents of Fragaria vesca var. roseiflora include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
